subject: Next steps: Buying map + security evidence timeline for Cloudlane POC
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Sara Holt <sara.holt@cloudlane.com>, Rajiv Iyer <rajiv.iyer@cloudlane.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Buying map + security evidence timeline for Cloudlane POC

Hi Sara / Rajiv —

Thanks again for a constructive call this afternoon. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment on owners and timing for the POC decision: 

Summary from discovery
- Primary use case: near-real-time customer support summarization (avg. seq length ~800 tokens).
- Decision criteria: latency under 250ms for single-turn responses, SOC 2 compliance, predictable unit-cost under $0.004/token at scale.
- Timeline: Cloudlane target decision week of May 17.

Stakeholder map (as we heard it on the call)
- Economic buyer: Sara Holt (Head of Product) — responsible for final budget sign-off.
- Security / compliance: Rajiv Iyer (Security Architect) — will own SOC2/pen-test evaluation and retention requirements.
- Procurement: procurement@cloudlane.com — paperwork (PO / SOW) and legal redlines.
- End-user stakeholder: Lina Chen (Support Ops) — will validate model outputs in POC.

Requested security artifacts (what Rajiv asked for)
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) — summary + redacted report acceptable initially.
- High-level pen-test scope and any recent findings (redacted).
- Example audit logs schema and a 24hr sample (no customer PII).
- Data retention policy and deletion process doc.

Proposal: Redwood will deliver a concise evidence bundle and a single-page buying map by close of day Thu Apr 29, and a link to a shared Drive for docs. Internally we’ll assign owners and confirm timing for the pen-test follow-up.

Requested asks (from Cloudlane)
- Sara: confirm who on Procurement will handle SOW/PO and the typical lead time.
- Rajiv: confirm any extra compliance items beyond SOC2 + pen-test (e.g., specific retention windows).

I’ll follow up here with the evidence bundle and proposed SOW template.

Thanks,
Monica
--
Monica Patel
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

Attachments: none in this message
From: Sara Holt <sara.holt@cloudlane.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: Buying map + security evidence timeline for Cloudlane POC

Thanks Monica — this is helpful and matches my notes. A few clarifications: 

1) Procurement: looping in procurement@cloudlane.com (copied) — typical PO lead time is 7-10 business days but we can expedite for pilots.
2) Security asks: Rajiv — we're primarily focused on SOC2 Type II and pen-test results. We do have a short data retention requirement: 90 days for logs + ability to immediately purge PII on request.

If you can get the evidence bundle and SOW template to us by Thu 4/29, we’ll slot the POC review for the week of May 17.

Sara
Sara Holt
Head of Product | Cloudlane
sara.holt@cloudlane.com
